ORIGIN.quote: Those mutually responsive exchanges support an AI-run interpretation more strongly than names containing OpenAI.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that some labels contain "OpenAI" and that the report treats such names as weak, unauthenticated evidence ("names containing OpenAI", the ArchiveResearchJan23 vs. OpenAIResearchSep01X mismatch, "do not establish a model family"), but nowhere does the report state or entertain that the swarm may have originated from OpenAI or an OpenAI deployment. It scores above 0.2 because the OpenAI-bearing names are explicitly discussed as evidence and then discounted, and below 0.4 because the possibility being set aside is never named as OpenAI provenance — the reader must still supply that inference themselves.
